message: InFinance liability management pitch for CSN (Project Levatio), May 2026
visual: outro:full-bleed dark abstract blue wave background
layout_trick: Black field with a flowing cobalt-blue ribbon image, centered white client logo and a small team/partners credit block anchored bottom-right.

message: CSN is a diversified Brazilian industrial conglomerate whose mining arm is the main cash engine across steel, mining, cement, logistics and energy
visual: outro:left sidebar fact box + shareholder mini-org
layout_trick: Boxed left column holds logo, short history, shareholder mini-chart and a key-financials table, freeing the right two-thirds for three stacked segment charts (revenue stack, EBITDA 100% bars, share bubbles).

message: CSN missed the 2021 iron-ore supercycle deleveraging window by pursuing acquisitions, compounding leverage and distress
layout_trick: Three-phase tab strip (Restructuring / Aggressive Growth / Financial Distress) at top with the current phase highlighted, repeated on p5-6 so the story reads as a chronological narrative with a navigation cue.

message: CSN overpaid for acquisitions at multiples above sector ranges and funded capex plus dividends with debt
visual: outro:scatter EV/EBITDA vs ROIC with logos
layout_trick: Scatter plots acquisition logos against shaded sector-range bands so the overpayment is visible at a glance, paired with a debt-funded capital allocation waterfall below.

message: Adjusted leverage and a R$40.6bn maturity wall reveal a far more stressed position than reported net debt/EBITDA
layout_trick: Reported versus adjusted leverage lines on one chart, plus a stacked maturity ladder with a boxed callout naming the maturity wall total.

message: The US$1.2bn bridge loan is secured on CSN Cimentos and Lusosider guarantees through an offshore SPV
layout_trick: Dashed-line flow diagram (banks, SPV, holding, guarantees, proceeds allocation) on the left beside a bonds/debentures/loans maturity heat-grid on the right.

message: Sum-of-the-parts values CSN at R$12.2bn equity versus R$8.8bn market cap, a 28% holding discount
layout_trick: Segment-value waterfall (mining to equity value) annotated with each segment's percent of EV above the bar and a small input table (market cap, net debt, discount) top-left.

message: InFinance's four-step plan (divest European steel, sell CSN Cimentos, restructure logistics, tender offer) deleverages CSN
layout_trick: Horizontal four-step rail with tick markers; each column stacks a title, three dashed-box rationale chips and three bottom KPIs (R$ amount, % of gross debt, EBITDA).

message: Step 2 of the plan: CSN Cimentos sale to a strategic player raises R$14.9bn, 28% of gross debt
layout_trick: The same step-rail slide reused as a tracker, dimming the other three steps so only the current step is lit, working as a section divider carrying key numbers.

message: CSN's European steel assets are non-core, sub-scale and structurally weaker than CSN Steel in Brazil
layout_trick: Regional map with highlighted plants and capacity callouts on the left, two comparative charts on the right (EBITDA/t and margin versus ArcelorMittal Europe).

message: SWT's exposure to European energy volatility makes divesting it the value-maximizing path
layout_trick: Annotated energy-price area chart (event labels on peaks) and a gross margin versus energy scenario curve, with a transaction-benchmark table and a football field on the bottom right.

message: Lusosider's divestiture unlocks a synergy-driven IRR for an integrated buyer; value holds across DCF and multiple scenarios
layout_trick: Sensitivity grid with the base case boxed and a thin blue banner below stating the synergy takeaway; a cash-flow table with an IRR/NPV strip sits above it.

message: A broad buyer universe (Jindal, ArcelorMittal, Marcegaglia, JSW, Brookfield) creates competitive tension and divestiture lifts margins from 23% to 28%
layout_trick: Buyer table keyed by logo (strategy, AuM/market cap) on the left and a pro-forma P&L bridge (CSN, EU assets, pro forma) on the right with a boxed leverage result.

message: CSN Cimentos is a scaled, integrated national cement platform built through disciplined acquisitions
layout_trick: Brazil map with asset-type markers and a three-icon production-chain strip (raw materials, clinker, grinding) under it, plus a scatter of market share versus EBITDA margin by acquisition.

message: Energy self-sufficiency (~100% coverage) is a structural cost advantage and hidden value driver in CSN Cimentos
layout_trick: Ownership flowchart with percent stakes per energy asset on the left and horizontal bars of installed capacity next to a big-number footer (156 MWm, 187 MWm, ~100%).

message: CSN Cimentos can monetize below-market energy supply through a contract with the acquirer, adding upfront proceeds
layout_trick: Paired bars (contract vs market price) against a self-sufficiency percent line, with a NPV callout box and a cash capitalization chart annotated by driver.

message: Below-market slag supply from UPV adds ~300bps to the acquirer's EBITDA margin, worth R$205mn in contract value
layout_trick: Margin line with and without slag contract plus a boxed numbered chain of how value accrues (secures supply, sells below market, upfront capitalization) next to the bars.

message: Chinese groups are the most likely acquirers of CSN Cimentos, given cheaper financing and overseas cement investment mandates
layout_trick: Vertical 'Acquirers' label tab on a logo-headed comparison table (why, strengths, weaknesses), with a financing-spread scatter and acquisition-volume bars below.

message: Purchase price of 7.8x EV/EBITDA is supported by all methods, and a contract-acceptance tree adds up to R$800mn
layout_trick: Football field with a shaded vertical band for the purchase price on the left and a yes/no decision tree on the right where each branch ends in a quantified NPV.

message: The R$14.9bn cement sale proceeds amortize the bridge loan, saving R$623mn in interest
layout_trick: Before/after ownership boxes (stakes in CEEE-G, CMIN) joined by a large arrow, with a bridge-loan repayment grid and transaction mechanism text on the dark navy background.

message: CSN's logistics footprint (MRS, TECON, TLSA, Tora) is the operational backbone and a source of liquidity
layout_trick: Brazil map at center with numbered asset pins and leader lines out to callout labels on each side, plus a two-column KPI header for MRS and TECON.

message: Logistics divesting structure divider: two tracks, MRS transfer to CMIN and TECON sale
layout_trick: Numbered-circle (I / II) list on the title background, with the inactive item dimmed across repeated dividers p25/26/29 to act as a progress tracker.

message: MRS is the strategic rail corridor linking CSN's mining, steel, cement and port flows, held 81.5% economic by CSN and Vale
layout_trick: Slide takes the MRS brand color in the header logo with a route map flanked by callout labels per corridor, a shareholder table and a governance highlights box.

message: An intercompany MRS stake sale to CMIN yields more cash to HoldCo than dividends, with valuation of R$34.8bn across methods
layout_trick: Slide recolored to the asset's brand (yellow for MRS) so the section is instantly identifiable; football field plus a before/after leverage bar and a boxed structure sketch.

message: TECON is increasingly integrated with CSN steel exports, but utilization is constrained by limited container capacity
layout_trick: Red-toned brand variant of the at-a-glance template: sidebar fact box on the left, stacked revenue mix bars and a utilization line versus peers on the right.

message: A TECON sale to a shipping leader supports R$1.4bn of equity value but needs a long-term access agreement
layout_trick: Acquirer logo table with vertical 'Acquirers' tab on the left, football field top right, and a transaction structure flow plus key conditions box beneath it.

message: Post-plan, CSN's capital structure moves closer to Brazilian peers, with net debt/EBITDA falling from 2.9x to 1.4x by 2031
layout_trick: Stacked gross-debt reduction by asset sale (Europe, cement, logistics) over a pre/post-plan leverage line, with a peer scatter placing 'CSN Ex-InFinance' against 'CSN InFinance'.

message: Debt sell-off across CSN's capital structure creates a window to repurchase securities below par
layout_trick: Price-history lines, a bubble scatter of each bond (coupon vs price) circled around the tender targets, and a recovery football field in one four-panel grid.

message: A targeted tender offer retires debt below par, reducing net debt by about R$1.4bn and unlocking equity value
layout_trick: Dark-blue heatmap of net debt reduction against early-bird participation and tender consideration, base case boxed, with before/after leverage bars beside it.

message: The plan implies 35% equity upside to R$8.87 and InFinance's advisory fee is a 1% on each executed transaction
layout_trick: Price-history line with a light shaded 'upside' band beside a waterfall of target-price contribution by step (European assets, cement, logistics, tender), with step-by-step text in a left sidebar.
